name: Create a bot match and start play
description: Verifies the fastest critical workflow creates a lobby with a bot and enters a playable match.
steps: Enter the call sign Test Captain
Choose 1 starting bot and create the match
expected: A 4x4 board appears, Test Captain and Bot A have starting islands, and Test Captain can take the first turn.

name: Join a lobby and receive live roster updates
description: Verifies two browser actors can share a no-login lobby and see the same roster.
steps: Actor A creates a lobby with 0 bots and copies the match code
Actor B opens the app, enters the code, and joins as Scout
Actor A observes Scout appear without refreshing
expected: Both actors see the same match code and a roster containing both human players.

name: Play strategic actions and preserve replay
description: Verifies the core strategy loop changes energy and territory while recording an observable match history.
steps: Create and start a match with one bot
Charge on the first turn, then claim an adjacent neutral island on the next human turn
Fortify an owned island and later raid an adjacent enemy when enough energy is available
expected: Energy, ownership, shields, turn count, and the visible match signal update after each action; the replay endpoint returns the same ordered actions.

name: Reject an illegal or out-of-turn move
description: Verifies invalid actions do not mutate the game and produce a visible explanation.
steps: Create and start a match on mobile
Try to claim an island when it is not the human player's turn or when the island is not adjacent
expected: A visible error explains why the command was rejected and the board state remains unchanged.

name: Read public state, standings, API help, and final result
description: Verifies humans and agents can understand current state and the match reaches a clear winner.
steps: Open the Agent API link and inspect the documented actions
Play a bot match until one player reaches 8 islands or turn 28
Inspect the winner banner, standings, and match log
expected: The API help is readable, standings are ordered by islands then energy, and the finished match names exactly one winner.
